items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I said, Jimmy Hamilton... we got in touch with Jimmy, and he came in the band.

ctx.x: So anyway, after the weeks were over, Duke says, well, you know, we're going to go. You going to stay with the band? I said, well, you know, I thought I had a lifetime job at ABC. So I told him, no, I couldn't go, but I knew a clarinet player, a good clarinet player. And so he said, who's that. I said, Jimmy Hamilton.
